# GOS — Gastronomic Open Standard — AI Agent Protocol
# appId: gos
# Graph: /graph-data.json (1282 nodes, 7622 edges)
# Catalog: /api/countries/catalog.json (top 20 per country, via GOS-01)
# Ingredients: /api/ingredients/variants.json (via GOS-02)
# Substances: /api/substances.json (via GOS-03)
# Paywall: POST /api/agent/pay with {tier: "socio"} -> JWT via Cloudflare KV/D1 billing 20% handling (see site/src/lib/billing.ts)
# Billing: tier socio 20% handling, infra 100% + AI*1.1 (Cloudflare Workers AI), JWT required for /graph-data.json when agents scale
# SEO: JSON-LD Recipe/Ingredient/ChemicalSubstance via site/src/lib/seo.ts (GOS-03), sitemap.xml, robots.txt
# Docs: https://github.com/iberi22/gastronomic-open-standard-GOS
# PWA: https://iberi22.github.io/gastronomic-open-standard-GOS/
# Discussions: https://github.com/iberi22/gastronomic-open-standard-GOS/discussions (anchored to recipes/ingredients/substances)
